subject: [PATCH v2 4/5] mm/page_alloc: keep a zone's pagesets when it goes empty

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch prevents the freeing of a zone's pagesets when it goes empty, which can lead to memory corruption and leaks. The pagesets are kept for the life of the zone, similar to pgdat->per_cpu_nodestats, and only folded in during zone_pcp_reset(). This change is necessary because setup_zone_pageset() now reuses existing pagesets and zone_pcp_init() keeps them when a node is re-added. The patch addresses an issue introduced by commit 340175b7d14d, which freed the pagesets when a zone became empty.
